correctness.rationale: Unitary reduction to z=(z′,z_n), s=||z′||² gives u=−(1−s)^q. Its Levi eigenvalues include q(1−s)^{q−1} and radial q(1−s)^{q−2}(1−qs), nonnegative for 0<q<=1; missing z_n curvature means top Monge--Ampère vanishes. On each fixed z′ complex disk |z_n|<sqrt(1−s), any admissible PSH minorant w has boundary upper limit <=−(1−s)^q and the one-variable subharmonic maximum principle forces w<=u. Conversely u is PSH and lies below φ=−|z_n|^{2q} since |z_n|²<1−s, giving envelope equality; the unit-sphere trace matches. Minimum u=−1 iff z′=0. For q>1 the radial eigenvalue is negative whenever s>1/q, available for n>=2, so same closed form is not PSH. The analytic proof is full, not inferred from experiments.
